title: Gulf dead zone: current 5-year average vs 2035 reduction goal (square miles)

source.name: Hypoxia Task Force Action Plan / Coastal Goal
source.publisher: US EPA / Mississippi River-Gulf of Mexico Watershed Hypoxia Task Force

notes: The Task Force's Coastal Goal (adopted 2015) is to shrink the five-year running-average hypoxic zone to under 5,000 sq km (~1,900 sq mi) by 2035. The current five-year average, 3,745 sq mi, is nearly double that target.
